author: claude-code
units: world px, origin top-left, north up. Same space as village-center/center.gd (world_bounds 3200x2240).
rules: Every building faces south (toward the camera) and its door opens onto a path along its south edge.
Water does the wayfinding: walking upstream along the creek reaches the fish pond, and the canal runs west to the fields.
Keep three landmarks visible from the plaza: the fire-watch tower, the shrine torii and the big camphor tree.
The plaza is 400 px across, so it fits in one screen around the bonfire.
Keep 110 px clear around every exit.

exits.note: via 西街, past the seed shop and the paddies

exits.name: 预留 待开发
exits.note: via 东路, past the livestock shop

exits.name: 预留 待开发
exits.note: upstream along the creek through the bamboo grove

exits.name: 预留 待开发
exits.note: via 南路 through the residential quarter

plaza.name: 篝火广场
plaza.surface: packed earth with a stone curb ring, not a paved slab
contents: bonfire pit at centre (night gathering spot for villagers)
4 lantern posts at the diagonals, r=180, strung with paper lanterns
festival yagura (tower stage), seasonal only, can stand over the fire pit

buildings.name: 青芽种子店
buildings.fn: Buy seeds, sell crops. Interior map already exists (seedshop-study).

buildings.name: 牧铃畜牧铺
buildings.fn: Buy animals, feed and tools. Set back along the east road so its door faces open road, not the bridge.

buildings.name: 小铃杂货
buildings.fn: Corner sweet shop: snacks that restore stamina, everyday tools, gift items.

buildings.name: 村民会所
buildings.fn: Quest/request board, village meetings and seasonal events. Natural home for AI villager conversations.

buildings.name: 望火台
buildings.fn: Fire-watch tower (火の見櫓). Climb it to open the overview map, and it rings the evening bell.

buildings.name: 稻荷小祠
buildings.fn: Small shrine on a hill. Daily fortune slip (small daily buff), festival venue. Torii at the stair foot (770,560), stone lanterns on both sides.

buildings.name: 团团的家
buildings.fn: Tuantuan's house, with a verandah and a laundry pole.

buildings.name: 居民宅 · 柿子巷西
buildings.fn: Resident house with a vegetable patch.

buildings.name: 居民宅 · 柿子巷东
buildings.fn: Resident house with a persimmon tree.

buildings.name: 暖汤屋
buildings.fn: Small bathhouse with an outdoor footbath. Restores stamina, and villagers chat here in the evening.

buildings.name: 水车磨坊
buildings.fn: Waterwheel on the canal mouth. Grind grain into flour, and later rice into rice flour.

buildings.name: 乡间车站
buildings.fn: Bus shelter with a bench. Fast travel to the maps you've already visited.

small_features.name: 村邮筒
small_features.fn: Red postbox: letters from AI villagers arrive here.

small_features.name: 大楠树
small_features.fn: Huge camphor tree with a shimenawa rope; landmark and rest spot.

small_features.name: 共用井
small_features.fn: Shared well: fill your watering can.

small_features.name: 地藏
small_features.fn: Roadside Jizo statues at the canal crossing (and one at 1880,1060). Leave an offering.

small_features.name: 洗衣石阶
small_features.fn: Stone steps down to the creek; villagers wash vegetables here.

small_features.name: 钓鱼栈桥
small_features.fn: Small jetty for creek fishing (smaller fish than the pond).

small_features.name: 梯田小块
small_features.fn: A few rice paddy strips near the west exit, showing that the fields lie that way.

vegetation.forest_border: trees 90 px deep along every edge, broken at exits
